direction: Experiment-owner direction, 2026-08-22: remove SwarmVault from the candidate set and delete its release copy. Stated policy: tools whose setup demands resources on this scale are not carried.

evidence.observed: In the provider-free host-integration dry run, `swarmvault init --lite` and `swarmvault ingest` completed on the prepared Fastify base (383 files imported, 2 secrets redacted), then `swarmvault compile` was SIGKILLed with exit 137 after about 71 seconds.
evidence.cause: Host memory. No container memory limit is set for the lane, so the kill came from the evaluation host: 7.6 GB total with roughly 1 GB free.
evidence.note: This was reproducible across two dry-run rounds and is a property of the tool's compile step on a fixture of this size, not of a single loaded moment. Recorded so the exclusion is not later mistaken for a token result: SwarmVault produced no weighted-token measurement and none is claimed.

retained_identities.swarmvault-owner: Left in place. It is a historical-profile evidence identity that frozen audits still refer to, so its config and registry record are preserved unchanged; only the two active candidate profiles were excluded.
